description: 臺北地區災時防災地下水井狀態資訊 [sewerage and wastewater and fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺北自來水事業處. 於災情發生時，提供民眾有關本處防災地下水井開設相關資訊，供民眾取水。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 臺北自來水事業處. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in kml. The portal shows 2026-04-02 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
